messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — Starlight preview cohort cap is at 22 seats but infra flagged throughput issues when >5 concurrent devs. Need to stagger enrollments and lock initial feature set. Can we align on enrollment windows and a lightweight feedback cadence?
Priya Patel: Good call. Do we have a date range from Starlight for their beta kickoff?
Maya Chen: They want to start week of May 4. Prefer two waves: 8 and 14. Also asked for a 30-min enablement + an ops Q&A.
Javier Ruiz: Re: throughput, we've repro'd perf drop at ~6 parallel requests w/ 4k context. Root cause looks like batching config hitting GPU mem ceiling. Short term we can throttle per-session concurrency.
Ethan Cole: @Javier can you draft the throttle suggestion and an ingress policy we can apply to the Dedicated preview pool? I can add it to the rollout task.
Javier Ruiz: Yep. Suggestion: per-tenant concurrentRequests=5, requestQueueTimeout=10s, and prefix caching enabled for common prompts. Snippet:
```
redwood.config: {
  concurrency_limit: 5,
  queue_timeout_ms: 10000,
  prefix_kv_cache: true
}
```
Nora Lin: I'll own scheduling. Proposing Wave A: May 4-7 (8 seats), Wave B: May 11-15 (14 seats). Enablement session May 3 11:00am PT (30m), ops Q&A May 5 9:00am PT (30m). Works?
Priya Patel: Works for me. I'll send invites and capture feature flags for the cohort.
Maya Chen: Also need a 1-question micro-survey after first 3 days and a 5-min funnel cold-start survey at end of week 1. Link to form: https://forms.redwood/test-starlight
Priya Patel: I'll set up the survey and a simple dash with success metrics: Avg latency, token cost per request, error rate, NPS micro-survey.
Ethan Cole: Noting a potential renewal risk if they hit latency issues during trial. Flagging for CSM special attention during week 2.
onboard-bot: Reminder: create calendar invites + share runbook doc https://docs.redwood/integrations/starlight-runbook
Maya Chen: Thanks team — @Javier please post the exact config PR by EOD, @Nora confirm invites, @Priya create survey + dashboard. I'll follow up with Starlight PM today. :thumbsup:
Javier Ruiz: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/1234 — config + rollout notes.
Nora Lin: Invites sent. Added hold for 30 min prep before enablement. :white_check_mark:
Priya Patel: Survey & dashboard live, shared with team. Will post metrics baseline on Monday morning.
Maya Chen: Great — closing loop here. If latency spikes after wave A, we'll triage and consider shrinking concurrency or deferring wave B. Thanks all.
